The [[Darkon system/Legends|Darkon system]] was the host of a '''battle''' during [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY's]] [[Orinda campaign]], which was fought as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly after the formation of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] won a string of victories along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] responded by sending the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', and the two sides clashed at Darkon. Commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and supported by [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], the ''Lusankya'' defeated Pellaeon's own ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought, the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']], and [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. The Imperials retreated, and further showdowns awaited.
